body.name: \(\mathsf B_{\kappa}\)
body.def: \(\mathsf B_{\kappa}(\mathsf G')\) holds when the mean domain of \(\mathsf G'\) is contained in the Euclidean ball of radius \(\kappa\), every covariance eigenvalue lies in \([\kappa^{-1},\kappa]\), and every lower or upper endpoint has at most \(\kappa\) affine pieces whose intercept magnitudes and normal norms are at most \(\kappa\).
